description: Build a comprehensive payout system for partners that supports multiple payment methods (Stripe Connect, PayPal, stablecoins) and includes automated reminders, webhook handling, and payout state management. The system should handle the complete payout lifecycle from initiation to processing and tracking.
functional_requirements: Implement payout method management for partners including Stripe Connect, PayPal, and stablecoin options
Create webhook handlers for payment provider events (Stripe account updates, PayPal callbacks, recipient changes)
Build automated payout reminder system for partners with pending payouts
Develop idempotent payout creation and processing logic to prevent duplicate transactions
Implement partner payout state management with recomputation capabilities
Create payout settings management interface for partner profiles
